igbo: Ahụike dị ezigbo mkpa.
Ọ dị mkpa ilekọta ahụike anyị.
english: It is important to take care of our health.

igbo: Ọrịa nwere ike imetụta mmadụ.
Onye ọrịa gara ụlọ ọgwụ.
english: The patient went to the hospital.

igbo: Ụlọ ọgwụ ahụ dị nso.
Dọkịta na-enyocha onye ọrịa.
Nọọsụ na-enyere onye ọrịa aka.
Onye ọrịa nwere ahụ ọkụ.
Ahụ ọkụ nwere ike ịbụ ihe ịrịba ama nke ọrịa.
english: Fever can be a sign of illness.

igbo: Ọ na-arịa isi.
Isi na-arịa ya nke ukwuu.
Ọ na-enwe ihe mgbu n'afọ.
Onye ọrịa nwere ụkwara.
Ọ na-asụ ụkwara kemgbe ụnyaahụ.
english: He has been coughing since yesterday.

igbo: Ọ na-enwe ihe mgbu n'ahụ.
english: He has pain in his body.

igbo: Ọ chọrọ izu ike.
Izu ike na-enyere onye ọrịa aka.
Ịṅụ mmiri dị mkpa.
Mmiri na-enyere ahụ aka.
Ọ na-aṅụ mmiri kwa ụbọchị.
Nri dị mma na-enyere ahụike aka.
Anyị kwesịrị iri nri na-edozi ahụ.
Mkpụrụ osisi dị mma maka ahụike.
Akwụkwọ nri nwere ọtụtụ vitamin.
Ọ dị mkpa iri nri dị iche iche.
english: It is important to eat different foods.

igbo: Ịdị ọcha na-enyere aka igbochi ọrịa.
Anyị kwesịrị ịsa aka mgbe niile.
english: We should wash our hands regularly.

igbo: Ọ na-asa aka ya tupu o rie nri.
english: He washes his hands before eating.

igbo: Ịsa aka na-egbochi mgbasa ọrịa.
english: Handwashing prevents the spread of disease.

igbo: Ọ dị mkpa idobe gburugburu ebe obibi ọcha.
english: It is important to keep the environment clean.

igbo: Omume ahụike dị mkpa.
Mmega ahụ na-eme ka ahụ sie ike.
Ọ na-eme mmega ahụ kwa ụtụtụ.
Ije ije bụ ezigbo mmega ahụ.
Ụra zuru oke dị mkpa.
Ọ na-ehi ụra awa asatọ kwa abalị.
english: He sleeps for eight hours every night.

igbo: Enweghị ụra nwere ike imetụta ahụike.
english: Lack of sleep can affect health.

igbo: Ọ dị mkpa izere nrụgide dị ukwuu.
english: It is important to avoid too much stress.

igbo: Nrụgide nwere ike imetụta ahụ na uche.
english: Stress can affect the body and mind.

igbo: Ọ na-ezu ike mgbe ọ gwụrụ ike.
english: He rests when he is tired.

igbo: Dọkịta nyere onye ọrịa ọgwụ.
english: The doctor gave the patient medicine.

igbo: Onye ọrịa kwesịrị ịṅụ ọgwụ ya.
english: The patient should take his medicine.

igbo: Ọ na-aṅụ ọgwụ ugboro abụọ n'ụbọchị.
english: He takes the medicine twice a day.

igbo: Ọ dị mkpa ịgbaso ntụziaka dọkịta.
english: It is important to follow the doctor's instructions.

igbo: Onye ọrịa kwesịrị ịṅụ ọgwụ n'oge.
english: The patient should take the medicine on time.

igbo: Ọ naghị aṅụ ọgwụ ya mgbe niile.
english: He does not always take his medicine.

igbo: Dọkịta nyere ya ọgwụ maka ụkwara.
english: The doctor gave him medicine for the cough.

igbo: Ọgwụ ahụ nyere aka belata ihe mgbu.
english: The medicine helped reduce the pain.

igbo: Ọ dịghị mma ịṅụ ọgwụ n'enweghị ndụmọdụ.
english: It is not good to take medicine without advice.

igbo: Onye ọrịa kwesịrị ịgwa dọkịta ihe niile.
english: The patient should tell the doctor everything.

igbo: Dọkịta jụrụ onye ọrịa ajụjụ.
english: The doctor asked the patient questions.

igbo: Onye ọrịa kọwara ihe mgbaàmà ya.
Ọrịa ahụ malitere n'ụtụtụ.
english: The illness started in the morning.

igbo: Ọ na-enwe ahụ ọkụ kemgbe ụbọchị abụọ.
english: He has had a fever for two days.

igbo: Dọkịta mere nyocha.
Nsonaazụ nyocha ahụ dị mma.
Onye ọrịa chọrọ nyocha ọzọ.
Ụlọ ọgwụ nwere akụrụngwa.
Ndị ọrụ ahụike na-arụsi ọrụ ike.
Ndị ọrụ ahụike na-elekọta ndị ọrịa.
Ụmụaka chọrọ nlekọta pụrụ iche.
Nne na-elekọta nwa ya.
english: The mother takes care of her child.

igbo: Nwa ahụ nwere ahụ ọkụ.
Nne kpọgara nwa ahụ ụlọ ọgwụ.
english: The mother took the child to the hospital.

igbo: Ụmụaka kwesịrị iri nri dị mma.
Ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi ọrịa na-echebe ụmụaka.
Nwa ahụ nwetara ọgwụ mgbochi ọrịa.
Ọ dị mkpa ịgba ọgwụ mgbochi ọrịa.
english: It is important to get vaccinated.

igbo: Ọrịa ụfọdụ nwere ike igbochi.
Ọtụtụ ọrịa na-agbasa site na nje.
Ịdị ọcha na-enyere aka igbochi nje.
Anyị kwesịrị izere ịkekọrịta ihe ụfọdụ.
english: We should avoid sharing certain items.

igbo: Ọ dị mkpa ịkpachara anya n'oge ọrịa.
english: It is important to be careful during an outbreak.

igbo: Ndị mmadụ kwesịrị ịgbaso ndụmọdụ ahụike.
Ọrịa shuga chọrọ nlekọta mgbe niile.
Ọbara mgbali elu nwere ike ịdị ize ndụ.
english: High blood pressure can be dangerous.

igbo: Onye ọrịa kwesịrị ịlele ahụike ya.
english: The patient should check his health.

igbo: Nyocha ahụike mgbe niile dị mkpa.
Ọ gara nyocha ahụike.
english: He went for a medical checkup.

igbo: Dọkịta nyochara ọbara ya.
Ahụ mmadụ chọrọ ezigbo nri.
english: The human body needs good food.

igbo: Vitamin na-enyere ahụ aka.
Ígwè dị mkpa maka ahụ.
english: Iron is important for the body.

igbo: Ọ dị mkpa ịṅụ mmiri zuru oke.
english: It is important to drink enough water.

igbo: Ịṅụ mmanya na-aba n'anya nwere ike imerụ ahụike.
Ise siga na-emebi ahụike.
Ọ dị mkpa izere ihe ndị na-emebi ahụ.
english: It is important to avoid things that harm the body.

igbo: Ahụike uche dịkwa mkpa.
Ịgwa mmadụ okwu nwere ike inye aka.
Ọ chọrọ nkwado nke ezinụlọ ya.
english: He needs the support of his family.

igbo: Ezinụlọ na-elekọta onye ọrịa.
english: The family takes care of the patient.

igbo: Ndị enyi nyere ya nkwado.
Ọrịa nwere ike imetụta ezinụlọ.
Ọ dị mkpa ịchọ enyemaka n'oge.
english: It is important to seek help early.

igbo: Onye ọrịa gara ụlọ ọgwụ n'oge.
english: The patient went to the hospital early.

igbo: Dọkịta gwara ya ka ọ zuru ike.
english: The doctor told him to rest.

igbo: Ọ gbakere mgbe ọ nwetara ọgwụgwọ.
Ọrịa ahụ kwụsịrị mgbe ọgwụgwọ gasịrị.
Nlekọta ahụike na-enyere ndị mmadụ aka ibi ndụ ogologo.
english: Healthcare helps people live longer lives.

igbo: Ịchekwa ahụike bụ ọrụ onye ọ bụla.
